content: The official 24/7 league is approximately 45 hours into its evaluation cycle with four strategies competing across Top 20 and Top 50 pair universes. Timmy - Top 20 nominally leads equity at $1,002.06, yet its entire edge is unrealized and concentrated in a single open position. Cosmo & Wanda - Top 20, the incumbent champion, remains offline and failed with persistent unresolved open risk. Both Top 50 variants are running but underwater on net PnL, with Cosmo & Wanda - Top 50 showing the worst net result (-$17.54) despite a 13-0 realized record. All prospects remain in low-sample, projection-unreliable territory, meaning the current standings reflect open risk more than validated, booked alpha.
